## BOOKING - Incoming Social Message
**Meta webhook**: `GET/POST /webhook/social/meta` — set it as the callback URL of your Meta app (Instagram + Messenger, field `messages`). Verify token: env `META_VERIFY_TOKEN`; signatures are checked with env `META_APP_SECRET` when it is set.

**Test chat**: `POST /webhook/social/test` with `{"userId":"tester-1","message":"Hi, I want to book a massage tomorrow"}` — the reply comes back in the response.

meta.description: Receives Instagram and Facebook Messenger messages (Meta webhook) and test messages, runs one conversation turn per message and sends the reply.
